_arm_note: Hierarchical PPO with hybrid action heads (Categorical primitive + Gaussian Dx/Dy/Dtheta). Replaces the failed TD3 setup. Path-2 architecture: single network used across all stages; stage 1 only enables param-free primitives so the Gaussian head sits idle but stays trainable, then stage 2+ unlocks primitives that read its outputs. See TRAINING.md and /Users/Adnan/.claude/plans/sprightly-singing-kite.md for the full rationale.

stage1_015_warm.description: DISABLED (timesteps=0). Stage 1 warmup was a TD3 holdover — its purpose was to bake in kick mechanics on an easy spawn distribution. PPO with hybrid action heads doesn't need that warm-start: the value function picks up the +150 goal reward just as fast at stage 1.090 alongside the more interesting kick-vs-turn discrete decision. Re-enable only if stage 1.090 stalls early and we want a 5k-step value-function pre-fill (in which case: set timesteps to ~5000 and keep this disabled_actions list).

stage1_090_mid.description: RUNG 1 — DONE (300k complete; 100% last-100 eps, bad_aim 90%→0.0%; checkpoint stage1_090_mid_complete.pt is the lineage root, loaded via top-level load_model for the overnight chain). EXPANDABLE-BACKBONE STAGE 1 — RUNG 1 (aim bootstrap), retrained from scratch on the new attention network (flat-MLP checkpoints can't load into it). ball_y narrowed to ±6 so the goal window is wide enough to learn aim against the turn-noise floor (LOG_STD_MIN=-3.0). Adds `turn` (Gaussian Dtheta active via param_active_mask); kick enabled; approach_ball disabled (robot spawns within kickable_dist so approach is a no-op); dribbles disabled. This is the lineage root: rungs 2-5 (stage1_180_full/_y10/_y15/stage1_9) warm-start from this via top-level load_model, no rebuild. Flat-MLP §16 hit 94% goal / bad_aim 86%→4% from scratch; target the same bar. Budget 300k. New-lineage checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage1_090_mid_complete.pt.

stage1_9.description: COMPLETED 2026-06-04 (overnight chain RUNG 5, FINAL Stage-1 task: 85.7% overall goal rate, 90.0% last-100, action dist 71% approach / 23% turn / 4% kick). HOME-SPOT APPROACH → TURN → KICK: robot starts at home pose (-10, 0) facing a random heading; ball spawns at full distribution (x∈[5,30], y∈[-15,15]). Checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage1_9_complete.pt — THE STAGE-2 WARM-START (also copied to final_models/ppo_jal_expandable_stage1_final.pt).

stage2_0_placement.description: ACTIVE — STAGE 2 RUNG 1 (verify before chaining 2.1–2.3): SHOT PLACEMENT vs scripted keeper (ai_interface/goalie.py, driven by the env each cycle; obs context slot 0 = keeper pose, context_active_mask[0]=1). Spawn AT ball near the penalty arc, kick+turn only — isolates 'beat the keeper with corner placement' before dribble/approach are reintroduced. use_goalie_aim_gate switches the kick bonus and dense ball_speed/goal_progress gates to GOALIE-GAP quality; goalie_gap_blend_center=0.3 eases transfer from the stage-1 center-aim checkpoint (fades in later rungs). opponent_near_ball_penalty -0.1 (NOT -0.5: the keeper steps out up to 4 units, so -0.5/step bled 10–20/episode in the shooting zone — zone-avoidance risk). Warm-start: top-level load_model = models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage1_9_complete.pt. Acceptance: goal >= 50%, mean gap_quality on 'Kick fired' lines rising >= 0.5, keeper-shots (gap < 0.3) falling. Budget 200k. Checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage2_0_placement_complete.pt.

stage2_1_dribble.description: QUEUED (enable after 2.0 passes; budget 300k) — STAGE 2 RUNG 2: DRIBBLE REPOSITIONING. Adds start_dribble/stop_dribble (logit rows untouched since init — same unmask situation approach_ball had before stage1_9, which worked). Still spawns at ball, but ball_y widens to ±10 where direct shots have poor gap EV — dribble-then-shoot becomes the profitable path. Dribble session rules (JAL_env): 1.0 m SSL anchor radius, exhaustion forces drop, re-dribble needs separation > kickable+0.2. dribble_lateral_progress_weight raised 0.1→0.25 (at 0.1 the term maxes at +0.03/step — noise next to the 0.1 state bonus). stop_dribble_release_bonus 0.5 teaches the deliberate stop → re-approach → kick chain. Warm-starts IN-MEMORY from 2.0. Acceptance: dribble sessions in >= 20% of episodes, invalid start_dribble rate falling, goal rate >= 2.0's. Checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage2_1_dribble_complete.pt.

stage2_2_fullchain.description: QUEUED (budget 300k) — STAGE 2 RUNG 3: FULL CHAIN approach → dribble → turn → kick. Re-enables approach_ball; robot starts at home pose (-10, 0) random heading, ball at full stage-2 distribution. approach_weight 1.0 (stage1_9 EV math: park EV << goal 70). goalie_gap_blend_center fades 0.3→0.15; step_bonus -0.05 adds time pressure for the long chain. Warm-starts IN-MEMORY from 2.1. Acceptance: goal >= 50% over final 1000 eps; no primitive > 90% in any 100-ep window. Checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage2_2_fullchain_complete.pt.

stage2_3_anneal.description: QUEUED (budget 150k) — STAGE 2 RUNG 4: ANNEAL the crutches. Same task as 2.2 but goalie_gap_blend_center 0.0 (pure gap — center shots earn no kick bonus) and kick_into_keeper_penalty 3.0, making an on-target shot at the keeper EV-NEGATIVE (0·gap·20 − 3.0 < 0) instead of mildly positive; dribble shaping halves (state bonus 0.05, lateral back to 0.1) so the skill stands on the goal reward. Warm-starts IN-MEMORY from 2.2. Acceptance: goal >= 60% last-1000 with blend 0; placement (mean gap_quality) holds vs 2.2. Checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage2_3_anneal_complete.pt — the Stage-2 final.
